newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASKETBALL-BARCELONA BACK TO WINNING WAYS TOO LATE.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-BARCELONA BACK TO WINNING WAYS TOO LATE.

text.p: Barcelona's fortunes changed at last on Thursday with a 79-71 win against Bayer Leverkusen in the men's EuroLeague basketball.

But although Barcelona improved their position in group C, other results conspired against them and the Spanish side, out of the top three, now face a tough schedule in the second phase against top Group D sides, starting on January 9.
Runners-up in last season's competition, Barcelona have been going through a tough patch but they took their chances against the Germans who have now lost all nine of their EuroLeague matches.
But Dirk Bauermann's team didn't lack fighting spirit and got off to a good start, leading 17-10 after only eight minutes.
However, Barcelona led 40-30 at halftime and although Leverkusen staged an impressive comeback to close within three points, the Spanish side swiftly went clear again.
American Toni Dawson and international star Tim Nees were Leverkusen's best shooters with 23 and 13 points respectively. Barcelona's Xavi Fernandez was their best scorer with an excellent 25 points.
